identity.name: Residential unit in Maringá, Brazil (BE Deodoro)

about.description: BSPT-BRV-1 is a Blocksquare property token recorded on Ethereum under the name Residential unit in Maringá, Brazil (BE Deodoro). The on chain property record gives an address of Residencial BE Deodoro - Rua Marechal Deodoro, 987, Zona 07 87.030.020 Maringá, Paraná, Brazil together with geographic coordinates. No valuation has been set on either the token or the Blocksquare property registry, so the entry exists as a registered property token without a stated value. A maximum supply is set and a small quantity of tokens has been issued, so the entry is partially launched rather than dormant. Under the Blocksquare framework a property token conveys an economic interest routed through the entity that owns the property rather than direct legal title, holding requires passing the platform's onboarding checks, transfers are limited to approved addresses, yield reaches holders as distributed rental income paid in DAI, and no issuer redemption facility exists. This token was not part of the issuer's own submission and was identified from the Blocksquare marketplace indexer and confirmed on chain.
